bull_case: Management has repeatedly shifted the product platform, raised guidance with execution, and used a modest Predibase acquisition to accelerate AI capabilities rather than a transformative empire-building deal.
bear_case: SBC and dilution remain high, founder/dual-class voting control weakens shareholder checks, and the economic return on Predibase and the AI expansion is not yet measurable.
thesis: Execution and strategic adaptability are better than capital-allocation proof. The company has moved from legacy backup to subscription cyber resilience and agentic products, while Q1/Q2 FY2027 guidance was raised. Governance is acceptable but not exceptional because dual-class voting and high equity compensation create owner-alignment questions. Predibase is strategically coherent but too recent for a high post-acquisition return score.

evidence.claim: Rubrik transitioned customers from legacy CDM to subscription RSC beginning in FY2023 and then expanded into identity and Agent Cloud, demonstrating strategic adaptation rather than preserving the legacy model.
evidence.source: SEC Q2 FY2026 10-Q and Rubrik 2026 product releases

evidence.claim: Rubrik acquired Predibase in July 2025 for fair-value consideration of about $109.1M, primarily equity, to accelerate agentic AI capabilities.
FY2027 guidance was raised after Q1 and again after Q2, while Subscription ARR grew 32% then 33% y/y and contribution margins improved.
evidence.source: Rubrik Q1 and Q2 FY2027 official results

evidence.claim: KPMG has audited Rubrik since 2018 and was retained for FY2027; no material weakness was identified in the reviewed proxy/filing evidence.
CEO Bipul Sinha beneficially controlled about 25.2% of total voting power in the 2026 proxy; Class B shares carry 20 votes per share. A lead independent director is appointed.
Outstanding shares rose about 5% y/y and H1 FY2027 SBC was $174.4M, so employee equity compensation is a material owner cost despite strong operating execution.
evidence.source: SEC Q2 FY2026 and Q2 FY2027 filings

counterevidence: Predibase's acquisition return is not yet measurable.
Dual-class voting concentrates control and limits public-shareholder influence.
Equity compensation is economically large and share count is rising.
The global sales leader resigned in February 2026, adding execution continuity risk.
unknowns: Predibase standalone revenue and return on invested capital.
Long-term normalized SBC policy after IPO-era grants.
Board effectiveness under founder voting control.
Post-acquisition retention of Predibase technical talent.
falsifiers: Cut capital_allocation if Predibase remains immaterial while dilution persists above 5%.
Cut governance_integrity on any restatement, material weakness or auditor dispute.
Cut execution_adaptability if repeated guidance misses follow the current expansion phase.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute or material internal-control failure was identified through the cutoff; KPMG has audited the company since 2018. Governance concentration and SBC are risks, not evidence of integrity failure.

next_checks: Review 2027 proxy for compensation redesign and dilution.

subscores.rationale: No buyback track record exists and Predibase is too recent for a post-hoc return test. The acquisition is small and strategically coherent, but current evidence supports only a modest-above-average score.
Long-standing auditor continuity and no identified reporting failures support good integrity, offset by dual-class control and economically large equity compensation.
Executed migration to RSC, repeated FY2027 guidance raises and rapid agentic-product expansion meet the 75 consistent-execution/adaptation anchor; longer-cycle evidence is insufficient for 90.

uncertainties.rationale: Predibase economics are not separately disclosed.
Founder voting control and SBC create alignment risk despite clean reporting evidence.
